title: SDK handwritten backport policy
description: Per-repo contract for camunda/sdk-infra's handwritten-only backport workflow. Lives at .github/backport.yml in each adopting SDK. A missing file is an error — the workflow will not guess paths.

skip-paths.description: Globs for generated / spec-snapshot paths. A commit whose changed files are all under these is dropped from the cherry-pick. A commit that mixes these with other paths is a hard failure (split the PR).

skip-subjects.description: Commit-subject prefixes that mark a regen-only commit. Matched as a case-sensitive prefix of the first line.

do-not-backport.description: Path globs that must never be cherry-picked from one line onto another (e.g. a generator that diverged between stable/9 and stable/10). If any remaining commit touches a matching path and the source/target lines match, the whole PR is skipped.

from.description: Source branch names this rule applies to. Empty / omitted = any source.

to.description: Target branch names this rule applies to. Empty / omitted = any target.
